Very basic question, because I came across this and a discussion was
going on in the post which i recently saw somewhere on RTM.Which of the 2
 figures can be called RBD=Supply and Why.

author: Pedini
text: Sorry mate, really don't understand your question.

author: harshrthakkar
text: Red Box on left qualify as RBD or the one on the right.

author: bigandrich
text:
Greetings, the one on the left represents a rally (price shoots
through resistance), the red box contains the base (which is also new
supply, sellers are over powering buyers), as supply overcomes the
buyers (demand) price then drops and leaves the supply Area ....the red
 box on the left represents only the base; the red box on the right
represents the complete rally base drop move...hope that helps

It's important to be competitive on your entries. But I never compete to
 exit (even though my exits should be as important as my entries). My TP
